items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: So Roy Bog was a piano player, one of the piano players at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you know Bix well?

Yeah, I knew Bix pretty well. Like I tell you, Moore threw that. And then he came down a couple of times when he was with Whiteman. He and Frank Trombauer were with Whiteman. We like broke the thing up. They did a concert, you see. And there was no jazz at all. So after the intermission, we were in the alley side. It was old St. Charles said up there. They've torn it down now, I think. Well, I was delegated to go up and speak to Whiteman and tell him that we wanted to hear some Bix and Tram, you see. So I walked…
You had to coerce Whiteman to get any jazz.
